H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H7549: properly, an expanse, i.e. the firmament or (apparently) visible arch of the sky
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H5042: to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor)
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
H2331: properly, to live; by implication (intensively) to declare or show
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H1097: properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H6957: a cord (as connecting), especially formeasuring; figuratively, a rule; also a rim, a musical string or accord
H8398: the earth (as moist and therefore inhabited); by extension, the globe; by implication, its inhabitants; specifically, a particular land, as Babylonia, Palestine
H4405: a word; collectively, a discourse; figuratively, a topic
H8121: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H2860: a relative by marriage (especially through the bride); figuratively, a circumcised child (as a species of religious espousal)
H7323: to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush)
H734: a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan
H4161: a going forth, i.e. (the act) an egress, or (the place) an exit; hence, a source or product; specifically, dawn, the rising of the sun (the East), exportation, utterance, a gate, a fountain, a mine, a meadow (as producing grass)
H8622: a revolution, i.e. (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H5641: to hide (by covering), literally or figuratively
H8451: a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H8549: entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H539: properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain;
H2449: to be wise (in mind, word or act)
H6490: properly, appointed, i.e. a mandate (of God; plural only, collectively, for the Law)
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H4687: a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law)
H215: to be (causative, make) luminous (literally and metaphorically)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H3374: fear (also used as infinitive); morally, reverence
H2889: pure (in a physical, chemical, ceremonial or moral sense)
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H5703: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H6663: to be (causatively, make) right (in a moral or forensic sense)
H2091: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H1706: honey (from its stickiness); by analogy, syrup
H5317: a dripping i.e. of honey (from the comb)
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H2094: to gleam; figuratively, to enlighten (by caution)
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H6118: a heel, i.e. (figuratively) the last of anything (used adverbially, for ever); also result, i.e. compensation; and so (adverb with preposition or relatively) on account of
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H995: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand
H5352: to be (or make) clean (literally or figuratively); by implication (in an adverse sense) to be bare, i.e. extirpated
H2820: to restrain or (reflex.) refrain; by implication, to refuse, spare, preserve; to observe
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H227: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore
H8552: to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H1902: a murmuring sound, i.e. a musical notation (probably similar to the modern affettuoso to indicate solemnity of movement); by implication, a machination
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H6697: properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous)
H1350: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property, marry his widow, etc.)
